selection: all 32 sources and all 128 planned inputs; retain construction quality flags and failures
sampling: all native frames, native resolution; this run requires 8 FPS CFR so Origin samples identically; other cadence is unsupported, never silently resampled
query_phases: each native frame, full-video backwards completion, fixed cell centers
regions: same-video SAM ViT-H AMG, native middle frame; no partner masks or prompts
decomposition: unchanged regional_reversal_ablation; preserve each region affine projection and each point mean velocity; do not remove unknown pairs
decision: both raw-grid ablation and guarded candidate use all 144 grid predictions; top floor(0.05*144)=7 displacement magnitudes; threshold 6*short_side/256; moving-pair count >= round(frame_count/4)
decision_scale_fit: none; official threshold/count reused, no tuning after observing this batch
visibility: reported separately, never discards coordinates from score denominator; learned proxy, not independent physical validation
primary_aggregation: mean across 32 source groups of paired CF mean over seeds minus base; never MAE or mean positive-only differences
numerical_criterion: Delta_guarded <= 0.10*Delta_origin only if Delta_origin > 0 and all 32 groups complete
limitations: New binary head makes dynamic-proportion scales comparable but does not calibrate tracking accuracy. Previous five sources informed development. No validated physical correspondence or natural-motion noninferiority; no claim of overall Repair success from this batch alone. New CFs have not received human semantic review.
